column5: Reentrant reclaim drains the vault in claimReward -- ### Summary `VaultManager.sol` lets a malicious token callback re-enter `claimReward` before the accounting update, draining more than the caller's fair share. ### Root Cause In `VaultManager.sol:claimReward()` the external transfer runs before the internal balance write.

column5: Rounding in the same file favors the protocol in settleEpoch -- ### Summary `VaultManager.sol:settleEpoch()` floors division on every call, so the protocol keeps a systematic one-wei bias per settlement. ### Root Cause floor division instead of a rounding-mode parameter.

column5: Generic swap-fee accounting collects dust from every user -- ### Summary A generic swap fee on every token transfer lets the protocol skim a small amount from each user across every chain. ### Impact Negligible per-call dust to the protocol at user expense.
